ops.en: THE FRAME. va-yedaber YHWH el-moshe lemor — the five-word frame (no etnachta: the stream splits the miniature at its strongest servant- stroke): the speech-formula in its tersest form, opening the consecration-command the night has just purchased: the machine notes the sequence — the event (12:29), then the title-deed (13:2): the firstborn spared become the firstborn owed.

THE CLAIM. QADESH-LI khol-BEKHOR — 'CONSECRATE to Me every FIRSTBORN': the night's invoice — the firstborn the strike passed over are claimed as the price of the passing (peter kol-RECHEM — the womb-opener term debuts, the legal handle of the class); ba-adam u-va-behema LI HU — 'in man and in beast — MINE is it': the possessive verdict in two words: the machine pushes the PERPETUAL card (the statu…

THE REMEMBER. va-yomer moshe el-ha-am ZAKHOR et-ha-yom ha-ze — 'REMEMBER this day': Moses' relay-deck opens (the speech runs 13:3-16: the memory-laws, the signs, the questions — one card for the relay, perpetual by content); mi-BET AVADIM — 'from the house of SLAVES': the epithet debuts (the Decalogue's own tag for Egypt, 20:2 armed); ki BE-CHOZEQ YAD hotzi YHWH etkhem — 'by STRENGTH OF HAND' (the…

THE MONTH. ha-yom atem yotzim be-CHODESH HA-AVIV — 'in the month of the AVIV': the month of 12:2's calendar-command receives its NAME (the ripening-ear month — the readings: He chose a month fit for the road, neither heat nor cold, named-only): the five-word verse stamps the date into the memory-law; the corpus notes the watch armed at exo_10 (13:4, the aviv) now paid: the machine files the calend…

THE VENUE. ve-haya khi-YEVI'AKHA YHWH el-eretz ha-kenaani — 'when the LORD BRINGS YOU' (the coming-word FULL here — the chapter's first skeleton of the pair, its lean twin six verses on [EX13-05]; MS: 'NO break here' — the printer's false parasha struck, asserted; the kaf soft, asserted); the five-nation list with the oath-clause (asher NISHBA la-avotekha — the patriarch-deeds cited again as venue…

THE WEEK RESTATED. shivat yamim tokhal MATZOT — and the matzot-word is LEAN (the third of the Masorah's FOUR — the sign transmitted at 12:18 pays its next station exactly where exo_12 armed it: 12:18, HERE, 29:2, Lev 2:4 [EX12-04's grid live]); u-va-yom ha-shevii CHAG la-YHWH — 'on the seventh day a FEAST': the chag-word of 12:14's card sounding in the relay: the machine files the restatement as t…

THE SEEN-BAN. matzot yeakhel et shivat ha-yamim — the passive again (the bread eats itself into the week, the readings note the impersonal — named-only); ve-LO-YERAE lekha CHAMETZ ve-lo-yerae lekha SEOR — 'nothing leavened shall be SEEN for you': the ban escalates from found (12:19) to SEEN — be-khol-GEVULEKHA — 'in all your BORDER' (the border-word of the locust-threat 10:4 now the leaven-law's j…

THE TELLING. VE-HIGADTA le-vinkha ba-yom ha-hu — 'and you shall TELL YOUR SON in that day': the telling-command proper — the HAGGADA'S name-verse (10:2's story-clause armed, 12:26's question-script pushed, now the UNASKED telling commanded: the readings' four-sons grid completes its third cell — the son who does not know to ask is told unprompted, named-only); BA-AVUR ZE asa YHWH LI — 'for the sak…

THE SIGN. ve-haya lekha LE-OT al-YADKHA u-le-ZIKARON ben ENEKHA — 'a SIGN on your hand, a MEMORIAL between your eyes': the tefillin- institution's first verse (the ot-ledger of 12:13 moved from the doorpost to the body; the Kitzur's ciphers named: the left arm, the Shema in the mouth); lemaan tihye TORAT YHWH be-fikha — 'that the TORAH of the LORD be IN YOUR MOUTH': the Torah-word's second counted…

THE SEASON [EX13-08 CROWN]. ve-shamarta et-ha-chuqa ha-zot LE-MOADAH — 'at its SEASON': the season-word FULL-vav and Torah-UNIQUE (VERIFIED) — MS: read LAMO EDAH, 'TWO WORDS: a TESTIMONY is it to Israel, that the Name is called upon them' (the tefillin-verse split into its own witness-formula); the Kitzur counting the vav: six weekdays bound, six festival-days free; MI-YAMIM YAMIMA — 'from days to…

THE LEAN COMING [EX13-05 CROWN]. ve-haya ki-YEVI'AKHA — the coming- word again, now LEAN in its second yod (VERIFIED: the Torah's ONE lean station, the Ramah's sign this very verse — against 13:5's FULL twin six verses back: one chapter, both skeletons) — and MS dismantles the phantom apparatus: 'the PRINTER ERRED who wrote a vav-form in the text and yevi'akha in the margin as a qere — THERE IS NO…

THE TRANSFER. VE-HAAVARTA khol-peter-rechem la-YHWH — 'you shall PASS every womb-opener to the LORD' (the pass-verb — the readings hear 12:12's I-passed-through returned as duty; MS's accent-ruling asserted: the word closes on a lengthener or mercha, NOT a tevir, kol raphe beside it); ve-khol-PETER sheger behema — the dropped- firstling clause (VE-KHOL PETER adjacent twice in the Torah, both in th…

THE DONKEY [EX13-07 CROWN]. ve-khol-PETER CHAMOR tifde ve-SE — 'every firstling of a DONKEY you shall redeem with a LAMB': the one unclean species with a redemption-rite (the readings: the donkeys that carried Egypt's spoil — named-only) — and the donkey-word LEAN by a DREAM (VERIFIED among the five thin skeletons of the letters, the four senses asserted): Berakhot's Bar Hedya to Rava — 'the VAV o…

THE QUESTION. ve-haya ki-YISHALKHA VINKHA machar lemor MA-ZOT — 'when your son ASKS you TOMORROW: WHAT IS THIS?': the second question-script (12:26's what-is-this-service was the rite's son; this is the redemption-law's — the readings' grid fills its simple- son cell: the two-word question answered with the whole formula, named-only; MS's accent on yad ruled: the revia, asserted); ve- amarta elav …

THE ANSWER [EX13-03; EX13-06; EX13-11 CROWNS]. va-yehi ki-HIQSHA faro le-shalchenu — 'when Pharaoh HARDENED against sending us': the father's history-lesson names the hardening (the Kitzur's Masorah- pair: 'WHO HAS HARDENED against Him AND PROSPERED?' — Job 9:4, 'which the midrash expounds on Pharaoh': the only Scripture that answers this verb is a question with no survivors; Sihon's Heaven- harde…

THE WEAK HAND [EX13-04 CROWN]. ve-haya le-ot al YADKHA — 'a sign on YOUR HAND' — written with a FINAL HE, Torah-UNIQUE (VERIFIED; the Ramah: 'bent kaf and full final he — all the rest of the Torah without it'; one of the Masorah's 21 he-ended words): and Rav Ashi reads the letter as law: YAD KEHA — 'the WEAK hand' — TEFILLIN ON THE LEFT ARM, derived from one quiet he (Rashi on the Torah at this pa…

THE ROUTE. va-yehi BE-SHALACH paro et-ha-am — 'when Pharaoh SENT': the send-verb's career closes in a temporal clause (the demand of 5:2, granted 12:31, now the backdrop; the Kitzur's cipher asserted at the build: et-ha-am = gam EREV RAV with the kollel — the sent people already counting its multitude); ve-LO-NACHAM elohim derekh eretz pelishtim KI QAROV HU — 'God did NOT LEAD them the way of the …

THE TURN [EX13-09 CROWN]. va-YASEV elohim et-ha-am derekh ha-midbar YAM-SUF — 'God TURNED the people... the REED SEA road' (asserted: 10:19's first naming pays — the locusts' grave becomes the nation's route; the Kitzur's table-derash named: 'He seated them around, as one sets a table in the wilderness'; MS's paseq on elohim beside the darga, and derekh dageshed, asserted); VA-CHAMUSHIM alu — 'and…

THE BONES [EX13-01 CROWN — THE MARQUEE]. va-YIQACH moshe et-ATZMOT YOSEF imo — 'and Moses TOOK the BONES OF JOSEPH with him' (the qof DAGESHED, VERIFIED — the taking-verb hardened at the receipt): the corpus's longest-armed card PAYS: gen_73 froze the oath at Gen 50:25 (PAQOD YIFQOD — the password's double verb, the four-station file closed at 3:16, the receipt pre-armed at this verse since the Ge…

THE STATION [EX13-10 CROWN]. va-yisu MI-SUKOT — 'they journeyed FROM SUCCOTH': the from-Succoth word lean-of-lean (VERIFIED pair: here and the itinerary's repeat Num 33:6) — and MS unrolls the Ramah's whole BOOTH-GRID: every sukkot-word lean-of-lean except TWO full (the sign: 'in BOOTHS I made Israel dwell,' Lev 23:43 — the festival's reason-verse), Jacob's verse carrying both the booth-form and t…

THE PILLARS. va-YHWH holekh LIFNEHEM — 'and the LORD was GOING BEFORE THEM': the guidance-machinery installed (yomam be-AMUD ANAN... ve-layla be-AMUD ESH — cloud to lead, fire to light; MS: NO lengthener in the lamed of la-nechotam, asserted); and the night- word stands TWICE IN THIS VERSE (asserted: ve-layla at tokens nine and sixteen — the Kitzur's SIX across Scripture named, with the wire lit: …

THE PERMANENCE [EX13-02 CROWN]. LO YAMISH amud he-anan yomam ve-amud ha-esh layla — 'it shall NOT DEPART': the not-depart frame's exact Torah-pair (VERIFIED): the pillars here — and JOSHUA (Exod 33:11: 'his attendant, the youth, DID NOT DEPART from within the tent'): the Kitzur — 'as the clouds RELIEVED one another, so Joshua: learning by the fire-pillar's last light and the cloud's first — as the…
